presentation.title: Agency delivery lab
presentation.description: Explore five synthetic processes in 2D and 3D and switch between them: the in-house agency pipeline with shared resources, parallel design and rework, an agile vendor pipeline with CI/CD automation, an order fulfilment line with robots, software systems and a human spot-check, a customer journey through an online shop with phases, emotions and conversion, and a user journey through app onboarding with system steps, timers and counters.
